newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end sharply up on high expectation.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end sharply up on high expectation.

text.p: Blue chips gained heavily on nounting expectation of retail investors, who continued to buy, pushing Dhaka stocks 5.83 percent up, brokers said on Monday.

"Even inclement weather could not dampen the spirit of the small investors. So the bull-run continues. Expectation are rising on some companies offering bonus and rights shares, and also rumours," said broker Sabbir Ahmed.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange index rose 137.96 points or 5.83 percent to 2,464.47 on a turnover of 277.7 million taka. Of the 107 issues traded, 84 rose and 23 lost. Singer Bangladesh gained 1,785.57 taka to 19,646 and Beximco Pharma rose 21.10 to 287.28.
